name: BH Quantitative Charging Cutoff & Battery Guard
author: Bu Tai Hui Qi Wang Ming & HChai
description: Automated charging controller that enforces customizable upper charge termination thresholds (e.g. stopping at 80% and resuming at 70%) to maximize lithium battery lifespan.

seo.title: BH Quantitative Charging Cutoff & Battery Guard for Magisk & KernelSU
seo.description: Protect lithium battery health by automatically cutting off charging power at designated thresholds (such as 80%) on rooted Android devices.
